name: Judgment Order Benefit

blocks.text: The first time on a turn that you use your Judgment ability to judge a creature, you gain the following benefit based on your order:

items.text: You can teleport up to a number of squares equal to twice your Presence score. This movement must take you closer to the judged creature. You do not need line of effect to your destination.
You can deal holy damage equal to twice your Presence score to the judged creature.
You can vertical pull the judged creature up to a number of squares equal to twice your Presence score.
